# Relm

> A modular Elm-architecture (Model-View-Update + Side Effects) state management and UI framework for Clojure and ClojureScript on top of [Replicant](https://github.com/cjohansen/replicant).

Relm provides a pure, data-driven, functional approach to building user interfaces. It combines isolated local component state, a reactive global context, pure view functions returning Replicant Hiccup data structures, and deterministic side-effect execution.

## Core Mental Model

Relm adheres strictly to the Elm Architecture (MVU + Effects):

1. **Model (State & Context)**:
   - **Local State** (`state`): Isolated, private immutable map per component instance.
   - **Global Context** (`context`): Immutable map shared across all components (e.g. routing, server cache, session).
2. **View**: Pure function `(fn [state context] hiccup)` returning Replicant data structures. No reactive atoms, derefs, or hidden subscriptions inside views.
3. **Update**: Pure multimethod `(defmethod relm/update ::msg-type [state context message event] [new-state new-context effects])`. Returns updated local state, updated global context, and a vector of declarative side-effect descriptors.
4. **Effects**: Multimethod `(defmethod relm/fx ::fx-type [event effect-vector] ...)` executing side effects linearly. Effects can dispatch follow-up messages to the runtime.

```
DOM Event -> relm/dispatch! -> relm/update -> [new-state new-context effects]
                                                     |             |
                                            Replicant Render    relm/fx
```

---

## Suite of Libraries & Dependencies

Add the required modules to `deps.edn`:

```clojure
{:deps
 {io.github.conjurernix/relm.core     {:mvn/version "0.1.0-alpha5"}
  io.github.conjurernix/relm.form     {:mvn/version "0.1.0-alpha5"}
  io.github.conjurernix/relm.query    {:mvn/version "0.1.0-alpha5"}
  io.github.conjurernix/relm.reitit   {:mvn/version "0.1.0-alpha5"}
  io.github.conjurernix/relm.devtools {:mvn/version "0.1.0-alpha5"}}}
```

### Module Catalog

- **`relm.core`** (`io.github.conjurernix/relm.core`): Elm runtime, `component`, lifecycle hooks (`on-init`, `on-deinit`), `update`, `fx`, render scheduler, and Replicant dispatch integration.
- **`relm.http`** (included in `relm.core`): Declarative HTTP Fetch API side effects (`::relm.http/fetch!`, `::relm.http/abort!`), JSON/Transit/Text decoding, and request cancellation.
- **`relm.navigation`** (included in `relm.core`): Browser History API effects (`::relm.navigation/push-state!`, `::replace-state!`, `::back!`, `::forward!`, `::go!`, `::reload!`).
- **`relm.form`** (`io.github.conjurernix/relm.form`): Form state management, field registration (`form/register`), built-in/custom validators, dirty/touch tracking, and semantic HTML attributes.
- **`relm.query`** (`io.github.conjurernix/relm.query`): TanStack Query-style declarative server-state cache in global context, vector query keys, stale-while-revalidate, exponential retries, optimistic mutations, and hierarchical invalidation.
- **`relm.reitit`** (`io.github.conjurernix/relm.reitit`): Client-side routing with Metosin Reitit, automatic route/view context synchronization, declarative navigation messages, and HTML5 history event handling.
- **`relm.devtools`** (`io.github.conjurernix/relm.devtools`): Redux DevTools extension bridge, time-travel debugging, action history replay, action toggling, and formatted browser console logging.

---

## Quick Reference by Module

### 1. `relm.core`

#### Component Definition & Mounting
```clojure
(ns my-app.main
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [replicant.dom :as r]))

(defn init [_context {:keys [initial-count] :or {initial-count 0}}]
  {:count initial-count})

(defn view [{:keys [count]} _context]
  [:div
   [:span "Count: " count]
   [:button {:on {:click [::increment]}} "+1"]
   [:button {:on {:click [::decrement]}} "-1"]])

(defmethod relm/update ::increment [state context _msg _event]
  [(update state :count inc) context])

(defmethod relm/update ::decrement [state context _msg _event]
  [(update state :count dec) context])

(def Counter
  (relm/component
    {:component-id "counter"
     :init         init
     :view         view}))

;; Bootstrap
(r/set-dispatch! relm/dispatch!)
(relm/render js/document.body Counter {:initial-count 10})
```

#### Update Handler Signature
`[state context message event] -> [new-state new-context effects-vector]`
- Returning `[new-state context]` emits no effects.
- Returning `[state context [[::relm/dispatch! [::other-msg]]]]` dispatches follow-up messages.

#### Built-in Messages & Effects
- `[::relm/dispatch! msg-or-msgs]`: Dispatches message(s) immediately after update.
- `[::relm/dispatch-later! delay-ms msg-or-msgs]`: Dispatches message(s) after a timer.
- `[::relm/batch! effect-vectors]`: Batches multiple side effects.
- `[::relm/send target-comp-id messages]`: Sends message(s) targeting a specific component's local state.

---

### 2. `relm.http`

Declarative Fetch API requests via effects.

```clojure
(ns my-app.user
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.http :as http]))

(defmethod relm/update ::load-user [state context [_ user-id] _event]
  [state context
   [[::http/fetch!
     {:url             (str "https://api.example.com/users/" user-id)
      :method          :get
      :response-format :json
      :on-success      [::user-loaded]
      :on-failure      [::user-failed]
      :abort-id        [:user user-id]}]]])

(defmethod relm/update ::user-loaded [state context [_ {:keys [status body]}]]
  [(assoc state :user body :loading? false) context])

(defmethod relm/update ::cancel-user-load [state context [_ user-id]]
  [state context [[::http/abort! [:user user-id]]]])
```

---

### 3. `relm.navigation`

Browser History API side effects:

```clojure
(ns my-app.nav
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.navigation :as nav]))

(defmethod relm/update ::navigate-to-url [state context [_ url]]
  [state context [[::nav/push-state! nil url]]])

(defmethod relm/update ::go-back [state context _ _]
  [state context [[::nav/back!]]])
```

---

### 4. `relm.form`

Declarative form state inside component local state.

```clojure
(ns my-app.form-example
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.form :as form]))

(defn init [_context _args]
  {:form (form/create {:validate-on #{:change :blur :submit}})})

(defmethod relm/update ::save-user [state context [_ form-values] _event]
  [(assoc state :saved? true) context])

(defn view [{:keys [form saved?]} _context]
  [:form (form/form-attrs form {:on {:submit [::form/submit form {:on-submit [::save-user]}]}})
   [:div
    [:label "Email"]
    [:input (form/register form :email {:type "email" :required "Email required" :email true})]
    (when-let [err (form/error form :email true)]
      [:span.error err])]

   [:button {:type "submit" :disabled (form/submitting? form)}
    (if (form/submitting? form) "Saving..." "Submit")]])
```

#### Key `relm.form` Functions
- `(form/create opts)`: Initializes form state map (`:validate-on`, `:initial-values`, `:validators`, `:validate`).
- `(form/register form path opts)`: Returns Replicant input attributes (`:value`, `:on`, semantic attributes like `:required`, `:pattern`, `:min`, `:max`).
- `(form/value form path)`: Current field value.
- `(form/error form path touched-only?)`: Validation error message (optional only if touched).
- `(form/valid? form)` / `(form/dirty? form)` / `(form/submitting? form)`: Status queries.
- Built-in validators: `form/required`, `form/email`, `form/min-length`, `form/max-length`, `form/min-num`, `form/max-num`, `form/pattern`, `form/one-of`, `form/compose`.

---

### 5. `relm.query`

Declarative server-state caching in Relm global `context`.

```clojure
(ns my-app.posts
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.query :as query]))

(def posts-key [:posts {:limit 10}])

(defn view [_state context]
  (let [posts     (query/data context posts-key [])
        loading?  (query/loading? context posts-key)
        fetching? (query/fetching? context posts-key)
        stale?    (query/stale? context posts-key 5000)]
    [:div
     [:button {:disabled fetching?
               :on {:click [::query/fetch posts-key
                            (query/key->opts posts-key {:base-url "https://api.example.com"
                                                        :stale-time 10000})]}}
      (if fetching? "Fetching..." "Fetch Posts")]

     (when loading? [:p "Loading posts..."])
     [:ul (for [{:keys [id title]} posts]
            [:li {:key id} title])]]))

;; Optimistic Mutation with Hierarchical Invalidation
(defmethod relm/update ::add-post [state context [_ new-post]]
  [state context
   [[::relm/dispatch!
     [::query/mutate [:posts]
      {:url        "https://api.example.com/posts"
       :method     :post
       :data       new-post
       :on-mutate  [::query/set-query-data posts-key
                    (fn [posts] (into [new-post] (or posts [])))]
       :on-settled (query/invalidate-hierarchical [:posts])}]]]])
```

#### Key `relm.query` Functions & Messages
- Messages: `[::query/fetch key opts]`, `[::query/mutate id opts]`, `[::query/invalidate target opts]`.
- Helpers: `(query/data context key default)`, `(query/loading? context key)`, `(query/fetching? context key)`, `(query/stale? context key stale-ms)`, `(query/error context key)`.
- Invalidation helpers: `(query/invalidate-exact key)`, `(query/invalidate-hierarchical prefix)`, `(query/invalidate-all)`.
- Key builders: `(query/key->url key)`, `(query/key->opts key opts)`.

---

### 6. `relm.reitit`

Declarative routing with Metosin Reitit and automatic context synchronization.

```clojure
(ns my-app.router
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.reitit :as relm.reitit]
            [reitit.core :as reitit]))

(def routes
  [["/" {:name :home :view (fn [] [:h1 "Home Page"])}]
   ["/users/:id" {:name :user :view (fn [{:keys [id]}] [:h1 "User: " id])}]])

(def router (reitit/router routes))

(defn root-view [_state context]
  (let [view-fn (relm.reitit/current-view context)
        match   (relm.reitit/current-match context)
        params  (get-in match [:parameters :path])]
    [:div
     [:nav
      [:button {:on {:click [::relm.reitit/navigate-to "/"]}} "Home"]
      [:button {:on {:click [::relm.reitit/navigate-to :user {:id 42}]}} "User 42"]]
     [:main (when view-fn (view-fn params))]]))

(defn on-init [state context _args _event]
  [state context [[::relm/dispatch! [::relm.reitit/start router {:default-path "/"}]]]])

(def AppRoot (relm/component {:on-init on-init :view root-view}))
```

#### Key `relm.reitit` Helpers & Messages
- Messages: `[::relm.reitit/start router opts]`, `[::relm.reitit/navigate-to target params query]`, `[::relm.reitit/replace-to target params query]`, `[::relm.reitit/stop]`.
- Context queries: `(relm.reitit/current-route context)`, `(relm.reitit/current-view context)`, `(relm.reitit/current-match context)`, `(relm.reitit/path-for context name params query)`.

---

### 7. `relm.devtools`

Redux DevTools and browser console debugging bridge.

```clojure
(ns my-app.main
  (:require [relm.core :as relm]
            [relm.devtools :as devtools]
            [replicant.dom :as r]))

(devtools/connect!
  {:name            "My App"
   :max-age         50
   :trace-effects?  true
   :log-to-console? true})

(r/set-dispatch! relm/dispatch!)
(relm/render js/document.body AppRoot)
```

---

## Comparison Summary

| Dimension | Relm | re-frame | Elm |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **View Paradigm** | Pure `(fn [state context] hiccup)` | Reagent components dereferencing `RAtom`s | Pure `(fn [model] Html Msg)` |
| **DOM Renderer** | Replicant (lightweight data VDOM) | React (via Reagent) | Elm Virtual DOM |
| **State Model** | Hybrid: Local component state + Global context | Single global atom (`app-db`) | Single global `Model` tree |
| **Update System** | Open multimethod `relm/update` | Interceptor chain (`reg-event-db/fx`) | Closed union type `Msg` |
| **Side Effects** | Open multimethod `relm/fx` | Event fx map `{:fx [...]}` | Opaque runtime `Cmd` / `Sub` |

---
